Edgar, running in place of Frank Wright, who was down with 'flu, could not hold his opponent over the final stage. Our "B" team ran well to finish 8th, while our "C" side were placed 13th out of an entry of 28 teams, which proves how popular this form of racing is with the clubs.

We had two teams competing, and over the 1st stage our " A " and " B " were 9th and 10th, with only 4 seconds between them. Edgar took the " A " team up to 7th on the second leg, with the " B " side keeping their 10th position.
Edgar with Peter Courtney third, the next being F.

This event for the "Overseas" Cup was held on 23rd January at Wimbledon and with Ron Linstead an absentee owing to leg trouble, the winner proved to be J. Edgar, thus confirming his form in the Savage Shield race.

… George Beecham for a further consignment of flag material, Gordon Biscoe for making the Finish remain upright and Mrs. Edgar for the colourful flags she so kindly made for the starting pens of the County Senior race.…
